candidates.name: Codex CLI and App Server 0.169.0
candidates.decision_rationale: Wrap Codex's managed credential owner. Reconcile store changes and replace stale helpers across login generations.
risks: An account/read reply can be successful after failed renewal. Platform stores and external-token mode differ.

evidence.claim: The account read path can return metadata after attempting refresh.
Managed refresh rechecks account identity when reading storage.

maintenance.release_activity: Codex CLI 0.169.0 is installed and matches the researched official App Server source.
maintenance.support_status: OpenAI upstream. Recheck managed auth behavior on every CLI upgrade; no LTS guarantee established.

candidates.name: notify 8.2.2 and Tokio reconciliation
candidates.decision_rationale: Watch the resolved parent directory for file replacement, debounce hints and schedule same-owner reconciliation.
risks: Keyring changes, missed events and stale single-file bind mounts need a separate recovery path.

evidence.claim: Stable native watcher release.
Documents filesystem notification backends, polling and platform limitations.

maintenance.release_activity: Registry shows 8.2.2 as stable and crate metadata updated 2026-11-15.
maintenance.support_status: notify-rs upstream. Current registry activity is visible; verify supported OS backends and advisories before locking.

candidates.name: @openai/codex-sdk 0.169.0
candidates.decision_rationale: Wrap native start/resume and streamed items in the REST conversation contract and in the Codex-targeted plugin route.
risks: Explicit API key or inherited environment can select another credential. Generic caller-tool callbacks are absent.

evidence.claim: Release depends on the matching Codex CLI package.
The adapter starts the CLI per turn and constructs its child environment.
The thread API exposes text or supported input items and streamed native events.

maintenance.release_activity: Published 0.169.0 TypeScript SDK pins the matching Codex CLI 0.169.0.
maintenance.support_status: OpenAI upstream. Accept this pair for Spec; defer production pin until recent release cadence, advisory status and binary availability are checked.

candidates.name: @opencode/plugin 2.3.0
candidates.decision_rationale: Register a V2 provider with explicit model and tool capabilities, a pinned Codex execution route and preserved user overrides.
risks: A native OpenCode ChatGPT entitlement does not establish third-party usage attribution.

evidence.claim: V2 server plugins register through Plugin.define and provider hooks.
The V2 plugin contract is published in the new namespace.
OpenCode documents its own subscription sign-in.

maintenance.release_activity: 2.3.0 plugin release matches the installed 2.3.0 host and its tagged API.
maintenance.support_status: OpenCode upstream. Pin with the host; the supported minor range and upstream maintenance commitment are unverified.

candidates.name: @opencode/sdk 2.3.0
candidates.decision_rationale: Embed the server-side runtime with durable owner-scoped sessions and interrupted turns.
risks: Admission can precede subscription and a default memory database cannot support durable resume.

evidence.claim: The embedded SDK owns runtime and session creation and supports configuring storage.
The separate in-process SDK package is published.
Package checks cover imports under Node and Bun. Real release turns still require verification.

maintenance.release_activity: 2.3.0 SDK is published and the tagged repository has package verification for Node/Bun.
maintenance.support_status: OpenCode upstream. Treat production selection as conditional on release cadence, native dependency support and supported runtime platforms.

candidates.name: @opencode/client 2.3 tagged source
candidates.decision_rationale: Use as reference for attaching to a remote OpenCode server if remote attachment is later selected.
risks: It introduces a separately operated server and cannot supply the in-process runtime.

evidence.claim: The transport client calls a server over its client interface.

maintenance.release_activity: 2.3.0 tagged client source documents a remote alternative.
maintenance.support_status: Reference only; remote-client maintenance is outside the selected driver.

candidates.name: React 19, Vite 8 and Cargo build scripts
candidates.decision_rationale: Compile locked frontend assets through build.rs, generate an asset map in OUT_DIR and embed it in the Rust executable.
risks: Build-time tools can be absent from a production image that still requires a separate SDK worker to run harness turns.

evidence.claim: React 19 supplies the requested UI foundation.
Vite produces a browser deployment bundle.
Cargo supports generated outputs and explicit build-script inputs.

maintenance.release_activity: React 19 has an official stable release and Vite 8 is the specified major. Cargo build scripts are documented by the Rust project.
maintenance.support_status: Keep the requested majors. Exact patch releases, toolchain support windows and build image pins require a release check in Spec.

candidates.name: @ag-ui/client and @ag-ui/core 1.0.5 with upstream A2UI middleware contract
candidates.decision_rationale: Adopt the browser SSE client and adapt the activity-snapshot wire contract in Rust.
risks: Correct camel-case IDs, replay handling, explicit terminal errors and action correlation require interoperability fixtures.

evidence.claim: Published client pins the same core version.
Upstream represents painted A2UI surfaces as activity snapshots.
The middleware receives actions in forwardedProps.a2uiAction.userAction.

maintenance.release_activity: Published 1.0.5 client pairs with 1.0.5 core; a pinned upstream commit implements the middleware convention.
maintenance.support_status: AG-UI project. Stable release availability and source are verified; defer production pin until maintenance cadence and changes to the middleware/client contract are checked.

candidates.name: @a2ui/react and @a2ui/web_core 0.15.0, v0.9 wire profile
candidates.decision_rationale: Use the published v0_9 React surface component and processor with local catalog/schema validation.
risks: Renderer package version differs from the protocol revision. Reject unsupported versions and catalog operations.

evidence.claim: Stable renderer declares React 19 support and a v0_9 export.
The published processor accepts selected catalogs and an action handler.
Client action schema identifies originating surface and component.

maintenance.release_activity: Published 0.15.0 React and web_core declarations expose v0_9. React v1 wire export was absent from this release.
maintenance.support_status: A2UI project. Pre-1.0 API stability and long-term v0.9 support are unconfirmed. Recheck maintainer activity, browser peer support and wire compatibility before production adoption.

candidates.name: jsonc-parser 0.34.0 and toml_edit
candidates.decision_rationale: Use syntax-tree edits for user-owned JSONC and TOML. Prefer native client setup where its scope and reversibility are verified.
risks: Parsers alone do not implement ownership, scope, symlink policy, concurrency checks or atomic writes.

evidence.claim: Published Rust JSONC parser and editor.
The concrete syntax tree retains existing comments and whitespace.
The formatting-preserving TOML editor fits Codex configuration.

maintenance.release_activity: jsonc-parser 0.34.0 is stable; registry metadata updated 2026-09-27. Cargo.lock also includes toml_edit 0.22.27 and 0.25.11+spec-1.1.0 transitively.
maintenance.support_status: The editors have upstream ownership. Decide the direct toml_edit version after a maintenance/advisory check and round-trip examples; lockfile presence alone does not qualify it.

candidates.name: agent-client-protocol 1.2.0, existing Rust adapter
candidates.decision_rationale: Keep the repository's locked stdio ACP SDK and extend capability/error fidelity and editor provisioning.
risks: An editor registration can succeed even if the executable cannot complete a prompt.

evidence.claim: Zed launches custom ACP agents using an agent_servers entry.
AI Assistant documents a custom acp.json and stdio launch.

maintenance.release_activity: Cargo.lock selects agent-client-protocol 1.2.0, already used by the service.
maintenance.support_status: Retain the incumbent until protocol/client parity is established. Upstream maintenance cadence and new release support were not checked for this existing dependency.

candidates.name: rmcp 3.11.0
candidates.decision_rationale: Use the official SDK as the target transport layer for the four existing tools, gated on current-client and legacy behavior checks.
risks: Existing callers may depend on the hand-written 2024-11-05 response. Replacing transport before establishing client parity could break them.

evidence.claim: Published Rust MCP SDK.
Release provides stdio and Streamable HTTP server features.
The official SDK documents transport- and version-dependent behavior.

maintenance.release_activity: Official SDK rmcp 3.11.0 is stable; registry metadata updated 2026-11-17 and the release tag includes the required feature flags.
maintenance.support_status: Model Context Protocol upstream. No legacy-transport or support-window guarantee inferred. Defer replacing the shipping server until pinned-version compatibility and advisory review.

candidates.name: Proxy-owned OAuth grant exchange
candidates.decision_rationale: Keeping the refresh grant inside its documented owner avoids competing rotating-token writers.
risks: Reusing a previous refresh token after an uncertain exchange can invalidate or confuse the session.

evidence.claim: Network exchange and storage publication are distinct operations.

candidates.name: Existing OpenCode V1 plugin package as V2 adapter
candidates.decision_rationale: The checked-in V1 registration, keys and lifecycle do not implement the tagged V2 host contract.
risks: An existing project provider can mask a plugin that fails to load globally.

evidence.claim: V2 documents plugin export points and installation.
Versioned configuration uses scoped precedence.

maintenance.release_activity: Repository's V1 dependency and V2 host are different contracts.
maintenance.support_status: Rejected for the V2 target. Existing V1 migration rules belong to Spec.

build_required.need: Generation-bound credential resolution, watcher recovery, single-flight and redacted status
build_required.why_no_candidate: Codex owns exchange and storage. Proxy paths, keyring notification, request routing and in-flight ownership remain application responsibilities.

build_required.need: A non-recursive V2 provider bridge that preserves actual Pro entitlement and reports its tool contract
build_required.why_no_candidate: Neither SDK proves an arbitrary app's billing path or transfers native tool ownership to the other host.

build_required.need: Common REST conversation/events and an owner-scoped server-side SDK worker
build_required.why_no_candidate: The native SDKs differ on execution, events, persistence, tool effects, cancellation and approvals.

build_required.need: Effective settings API and reversible, versioned host provisioning for the full inventory
build_required.why_no_candidate: Syntax editors and client schemas cannot enforce application roles, effective precedence or safe machine changes.

build_required.need: Embedded chat, settings screens, asset route and deterministic build
build_required.why_no_candidate: UI and Cargo frameworks provide primitives. Product screens, runtime capabilities and release packaging are project-specific.

build_required.need: AG-UI snapshot projection, A2UI validation and action authorization
build_required.why_no_candidate: The renderer and schemas accept protocol data. Isolation, budgets, replay, actor authorization and revocation belong to the proxy.

build_required.need: Existing direct REST, streaming ACP/MCP, discovery, hooks and scoped memory parity
build_required.why_no_candidate: Transport libraries cannot decide application-level auth, model selection, feature status or compatibility promises.
